additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0392314-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R0 170002758] Stuck in preparing CRM:00921001331
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
Hope you are doing well.
The customer reported this issue, and we remotely rebooted the charger, but the problem persists. According to the logs, Outlet1 is showing as 'Preparing,' but no EV is connected. Please follow the steps below to address this issue-
Please do external visual inspection of the CCS plug. Do not unmount the plug, else claims to Phoenix won't be possible.
Please measure the CP pin to ground. If Voltage is different from constant 12V DC, then please replace the cable and to ship back to QM.
If the cable will be replaced, then the
consignment shipped from RC to QM
must include the following data:
ISP ticket number:
Serial number of charger :
Defective part name/MLFB:
Additionally, kindly share the following data with us for QM-
Defective part name/MLFB:
Component serial number:
Logs with marked error (CSV format preferred):
Active error flags before replacement: No
Device-specific error code
(if applicable): No
Outcome of wiring checkup:
Commissioning checklist:
Commissioning date:
Field service report:
Date of failure:
Did this happen on the 17th Nov?
Complementary information:
Complementary procedures:
Please find the MLFB for the spare part. When you visit the site, kindly carry a spare cable with you.
If you need any further assistance, please do notify us.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Beerpal Singh
